services.name: AVTransport

actions.name: AddURIToQueue
actions.description: Adds songs to the SONOS queue
actions.remarks: In NORMAL play mode the songs are added prior to the specified `DesiredFirstTrackNumberEnqueued`.

args.name: DesiredFirstTrackNumberEnqueued
args.description: use `0` to add at the end or `1` to insert at the beginning

actions.name: BecomeCoordinatorOfStandaloneGroup
actions.description: Leave the current group and revert to a single player.

actions.name: ConfigureSleepTimer
actions.description: Stop playing after set sleep timer or cancel
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator returns error code 800

args.name: NewSleepTimerDuration
args.description: Time to stop after, as `hh:mm:ss` or empty string to cancel

actions.name: DelegateGroupCoordinationTo
actions.description: Delegates the coordinator role to another player in the same group
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator has no results - should be avoided.

args.name: NewCoordinator
args.description: uuid of the new coordinator - must be in same group

args.name: RejoinGroup
args.description: Should former coordinator rejoin the group?

actions.name: GetCrossfadeMode
actions.description: Get crossfade mode
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator may return wrong value as only the coordinator value in a group

actions.name: GetCurrentTransportActions
actions.description: Get current transport actions such as Set, Stop, Pause, Play, X_DLNA_SeekTime, Next, X_DLNA_SeekTrackNr
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator returns only `Start` and `Stop` since it cannot control the stream.

actions.name: GetMediaInfo
actions.description: Get information about the current playing media (queue)

actions.name: GetPositionInfo
actions.description: Get information about current position (position in queue and time in current song)

actions.name: GetRemainingSleepTimerDuration
actions.description: Get time left on sleeptimer.
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator returns error code 800

args.name: RemainingSleepTimerDuration
args.description: Format hh:mm:ss or empty string if not set

actions.name: GetTransportInfo
actions.description: Get current transport status, speed and state such as PLAYING, STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED_PLAYBACK, TRANSITIONING, NO_MEDIA_PRESENT
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator always returns PLAYING

actions.name: GetTransportSettings
actions.description: Get transport settings
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator returns the settings of it's queue

actions.name: Next
actions.description: Go to next song
actions.remarks: Possibly not supported at the moment see GetCurrentTransportActions

actions.name: Pause
actions.description: Pause playback

actions.name: Play
actions.description: Start playing the set TransportURI

args.name: Speed
args.description: Play speed usually 1, can be a fraction of 1

actions.name: Previous
actions.description: Go to previous song
actions.remarks: Possibly not supported at the moment see GetCurrentTransportActions

actions.name: RemoveAllTracksFromQueue
actions.description: Flushes the SONOS queue.
actions.remarks: If queue is already empty it throw error 804. Send to non-coordinator returns error code 800.

actions.name: RemoveTrackRangeFromQueue
actions.description: Removes the specified range of songs from the SONOS queue.

actions.name: SaveQueue
actions.description: Saves the current SONOS queue as a SONOS playlist and outputs objectID
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator returns error code 800

actions.name: Seek
actions.description: Seek track in queue, time delta or absolute time in song
actions.remarks: Returns error code 701 in case that content does not support Seek or send to non-coordinator

args.name: Target
args.description: Position of track in queue (start at 1) or `hh:mm:ss` for `REL_TIME` or `+/-hh:mm:ss` for `TIME_DELTA`

actions.name: SetAVTransportURI
actions.description: Set the transport URI to a song, a stream, the queue, another player-rincon and a lot more
actions.remarks: If set to another player RINCON, the player is grouped with that one.

args.name: CurrentURI
args.description: The new TransportURI - its a special SONOS format

args.name: CurrentURIMetaData
args.description: Track Metadata, see MetadataHelper.GuessTrack to guess based on track uri

actions.name: SetCrossfadeMode
actions.description: Set crossfade mode
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator returns error code 800. Same for content, which does not support crossfade mode.

actions.name: SetPlayMode
actions.description: Set the PlayMode
actions.remarks: Send to non-coordinator returns error code 712. If SONOS queue is not activated returns error code 712.

actions.name: SnoozeAlarm
actions.description: Snooze the current alarm for some time.

actions.name: Stop
actions.description: Stop playback

actions.name: Browse
actions.description: Browse for content: Music library (A), share(S:), Sonos playlists(SQ:), Sonos favorites(FV:2), radio stations(R:0/0), radio shows(R:0/1), queue(Q:)). Recommendation: Send one request, check the `TotalMatches` and - if necessary - do additional requests with higher `StartingIndex`. In case of duplicates only the first is returned! Example: albums with same title, even if artists are different
actions.remarks: (1) If the title contains an apostrophe the returned uri will contain a `'`. (2) Some libraries support a BrowseAndParse, so you don't have to parse the xml.

args.name: ObjectID
args.description: The search query, (`A:ARTIST` / `A:ALBUMARTIST` / `A:ALBUM` / `A:GENRE` / `A:COMPOSER` / `A:TRACKS` / `A:PLAYLISTS` / `FV:2` / `Q:`/ `R:0/0` / `R:0/1` / `S:` / `SQ:`) with optionally `:search+query` behind it.

args.name: Filter
args.description: Which fields should be returned `*` for all.

args.name: RequestedCount
args.description: Paging, number of items, maximum is 1,000. This parameter does NOT restrict the number of items being searched (filter) but only the number being returned. Using 0 is equivalent to 1,000

args.name: SortCriteria
args.description: Sort the results based on metadata fields. `+upnp:artist,+dc:title` for sorting on artist then on title.

actions.name: GetAlbumArtistDisplayOption
actions.description: Get the current album art display option such as `WMP`, `ITUNES` or `NONE`

actions.name: RefreshShareIndex
actions.description: Updates the music library (share) index

actions.name: AddHTSatellite
actions.description: Adds satellites and/or a sub woofer to a (main) player. The satellites become hidden. The main player RINCON_* is mandatory. RR: right - rear, LF: left - front, SW: subwoofer
actions.remarks: Not all speakers support satellites or sub woofer. Satellites should be of same type (e.g. Play:1)

actions.name: CreateStereoPair
actions.description: Create a stereo pair (left, right speakers), right one becomes hidden
actions.remarks: Not all speakers support StereoPairs

actions.name: GetButtonLockState
actions.description: Get the current button lock state

actions.name: GetLEDState
actions.description: Get the current LED state

actions.name: GetZoneInfo
actions.description: Get information about this specific speaker

args.name: HTAudioIn
args.description: SPDIF input, `0` not connected / `2` stereo / `7` Dolby 2.0 / `18` dolby 5.1 / `21` not listening / `22` silence

actions.name: RemoveHTSatellite
actions.description: Removes a satellite or a sub woofer from (main) player. The satellite becomes visible.
actions.remarks: Not all speakers support satellites or sub woofer. Multiples RINCON_* are not allowed.

actions.name: SeparateStereoPair
actions.description: Separate a stereo pair
actions.remarks: Not all speakers support StereoPairs

actions.name: SetButtonLockState
actions.description: Set the button lock state

actions.name: SetLEDState
actions.description: Set the LED state

actions.name: SetGroupMute

actions.remarks: Should be send to coordinator only
